title: Method for hydrophytic plant sample preparation for light and electron microscopy (studies on Phragmites australis Cav.)
author: Fedorenko, Fedorenko, et al.

steps.title: Remove air bubbles and fix tissue
steps.instruction: Perform sequential air‑bubble extraction from stem, leaf, rhizome or root samples, then process the tissues with appropriate fixative solutions using vacuum treatment to ensure complete penetration.

substeps.instruction: Place plant tissue pieces in fixative solution.
Apply vacuum to the container to evacuate trapped air and promote fixative infiltration.
Release vacuum and repeat if necessary until air bubbles are eliminated.

steps.title: Infiltrate embedding medium
steps.instruction: After fixation, infiltrate the samples with the embedding medium by adding it in successive thin layers, allowing each layer to mix with the previous one before adding the next.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a series of embedding‑medium dilutions (e.g., 25 %, 50 %, 75 %, 100 %).
Immerse the fixed tissue in the lowest concentration for a defined period.
Replace with the next higher concentration, allowing time for diffusion and mixing.
Continue until the tissue is fully surrounded by 100 % embedding medium.
